offering_description.value: Operates a streaming service of factual and documentary programming sold by subscription directly to consumers, and licenses its factual content to distributors and educational customers.

primary_products.value: streaming subscriptions; documentary and factual video content

primary_services.value: educational video streaming for schools; content licensing

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers subscribing to the streaming app; B2B: schools, libraries and businesses licensing content, distributors and platform partners

end_markets.value: consumer streaming entertainment; education; media distribution

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly or annual access fees paid by individual viewers; licensing or royalties: fees for licensing content to distributors and educational customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: acquires and produces factual programming and sells it under its own service brand; software / platform: runs its own streaming app and platform, sold to consumers and institutions

geography_served.value: global: streaming available to viewers in many countries worldwide

specialization.value: niche specialist: factual and documentary streaming content

distribution_channels.value: online: direct-to-consumer streaming app and website; partners / resellers: bundles and distribution through third-party platforms and carriers; direct sales: sales of content and access to schools and institutions

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules, consumer protection and data privacy rules apply
